jobs.employer_name: DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH
jobs.description:
About the role

Are you passionate about building high-performing teams, deepening client trust, and turning complex software into a tool people rely on every day?

As Team Lead Customer Success, you'll take ownership of our Customer Success function for D3 and OMS clients — banks, traders and technical teams who depend on our systems to price, manage and distribute FX Forward and Swap prices around the clock. You'll lead a team of four responsible for day-to-day client support, build the processes and product expertise that are shared across the team, and shape a more proactive way of working with clients.

This is not a role where you inherit a finished machine. You'll inherit a strong product, demanding expert users, a good team, and a function that needs clear ownership, deep product expertise, strong tooling, and a proactive way of working. Working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering, you'll help define what a modern, efficient Customer Success function looks like for our market.

This is a hands-on builder role for someone comfortable with ambiguity, who enjoys getting close to the product and the client as much as leading a team.

Your Responsibilities

- Lead and grow the Customer Success team responsible for D3 and OMS clients, taking on full people-management responsibility.
- Own the quality of day-to-day client support, making sure questions are answered quickly, clearly, and to a consistently high standard.
- Own support escalation, ensuring complex, urgent, or sensitive cases move through the organisation in a structured way instead of bouncing between people.
- Build the team's product expertise so that a growing share of D3 and OMS questions can be answered directly, without relying on Product, Engineering, or long-standing individual experts.
- Own onboarding from a Customer Success perspective, so new clients and users understand the product and are set up for success from day one.
- Develop a more proactive way of working with clients — anticipating issues before clients raise them, and identifying where they are not using D3 or OMS to its full potential, reaching out with suggestions rather than only reacting to requests.
- Make client knowledge visible internally by documenting client setup, usage, stakeholders, infrastructure, and recurring issues, rather than letting it live in emails or individual heads.
- Create a structured feedback loop into Product, surfacing patterns, friction, and recurring issues from client interactions, not just direct feature requests.
- Help define and improve the tools, processes, and reporting used by Customer Success, including systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, and Jira.
- Contribute to a clear, shared view of client health, including key users, setup, risks, and commercial opportunities, working closely with Sales.
- Speak directly and frequently with traders, desk heads, application owners, and technical stakeholders at client banks.

Preferred qualifications

- Several years of experience leading a Customer Success, Support, or Client Services team, ideally in enterprise software or fintech.
- A proven ability to build structure, process, and ownership in a function that is still evolving, rather than only maintaining an existing setup.
- Strong technical aptitude and the ability to develop deep expertise in a complex software product like D3. This is not an engineering role, but you need to be comfortable with technical detail and credible with sophisticated users.
- Enough financial-market understanding to grasp why D3 exists, what problem it solves, and what our traders need from it.
- Comfortable engaging directly with senior, demanding stakeholders such as traders and desk heads, as well as technical and operations teams at banks.
- Strong track record of managing escalations and keeping complex cases moving through an organisation without losing ownership.
- Experience building or improving tooling, automation, AI-assisted workflows, reporting, and documentation practices within a support or Customer Success function.
- Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering.
- Fluency in English is required.

Nice to have

Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:

- FX, Capital Markets, FICC, Treasury, or electronic trading environments.
- Previous exposure to OMS or similar trading systems.
- Enterprise SaaS support or Customer Success in a technically complex product.
- Experience building a Customer Success function in a small, expert team, with a hands-on approach to clients, product, and day-to-day operations.
- Familiarity with SaaS environments and technical operations — infrastructure, connectivity, system monitoring — even though this role does not own technical operations.
- CRM or ticketing systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, Jira, or Teams.

What we offer as an employer

- Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.
- Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.
- Be part of an international workforce: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.
- Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.
- Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.
- Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.

About us

DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH stands at the forefront of the financial technology sector, renowned for developing cutting-edge software solutions. Our innovative products encompass a wide spectrum, from pricing and settlement solutions for FX/MM businesses to FX market data services. With over 40 prominent banks worldwide, spanning Europe, America, Asia, and Australia, among our esteemed clientele, we have solidified our position as a global leader.

At the heart of our success is our exceptional team, comprised of approximately 75 dedicated professionals boasting expertise in software development, financial mathematics, sales, IT systems, and more. Operating from three key locations—Hamburg (headquarters), London, and Singapore—we champion equal opportunities and foster a culture of respect and collaboration, ensuring a welcoming and supportive work environment for all.

Join us as we continue to redefine the landscape of financial technology with DIGITEC.

About the role

As Service Delivery & Supplier Manager, you'll own the end-to-end service lifecycle for our D3 and OMS platforms — from solution validation through onboarding, transition, go-live, and business-as-usual.

You'll govern service levels and delivery performance globally, define and continuously improve our service delivery framework and governance structures, and own supplier and technology procurement end to end — from sourcing and negotiation through contract lifecycle, renewals, and cost optimization.

You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Customer Success to keep our services and supplier relationships running smoothly, while also shaping the frameworks, governance, and processes that let this function scale as we grow. You'll be the person who ensures service levels are met, escalations are handled with structure, and supplier and procurement decisions serve both commercial and operational goals.

This role suits someone who's comfortable moving between governance, operations, and commercial negotiation, and who enjoys owning things end-to-end.

Your Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end service lifecycle from solution validation through onboarding, transition, go-live, and BAU, ensuring reliable delivery within a multi-vendor SaaS ecosystem.

- Ensure service delivery and supplier operations adhere to applicable risk, compliance, information security, and audit requirements, maintaining required controls and evidence while supporting the responsible oversight functions.
- Drive continuous improvement and evolution of the service delivery and supplier management operating model, leveraging cross-client and operational insights to support scalability, automation, and business growth.

Preferred qualifications

- Several years of experience in service delivery, service management, or IT operations, ideally within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
- Proven experience owning supplier and vendor management end to end — governance, performance management, escalations, and remediation.
- Experience with technology procurement and commercial contract management, including sourcing, negotiation, contract lifecycle, and cost optimization.
- Working knowledge of service management practices such as incident, problem, change, and release management.
- Experience defining and governing SLAs, KPIs, and OLAs, with a track record of turning performance data into action.
- Comfortable engaging directly with clients and stakeholders in governance forums, service reviews, and escalations.
- Familiarity with risk, compliance, information security, and audit requirements in a regulated or enterprise environment.
- Strong analytical and process-improvement mindset, with experience evolving service and supplier operating models at scale.
- Fluency in English is required.

Nice to have

- German language skills are a plus.
- Understanding of cloud, infrastructure, networking, and modern application/platform environments, sufficient to effectively manage technical suppliers.
- Knowledge of financial markets.
- Familiar with Jira/Confluence.
- Familiar with ITIL and/or ISO 27001, ISAE 3402, or SOC 2.

What we offer as an employer

- Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.
- Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.
- Be part of an international workforce: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.
- Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.
- Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.
- Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.

DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH stands at the forefront of the financial technology sector, renowned for developing cutting-edge software solutions. About Delos Cloud:
Delos Cloud, a start-up founded by SAP, strives to deliver a sovereign cloud platform for the digital transformation of the German public sector. The platform is an essential component for the implementation of the German Administrative Cloud Strategy (DVS) in compliance with all relevant data protection, IT security, and secrecy requirements of the BSI. Delos Cloud is a trusted partner of the federal, state, and local IT service providers and complements their service portfolio. Therefore, you will find exciting and varied tasks in an innovative and meaningful environment. For more information, please visit: www.deloscloud.de

The Role:
As Information Security Manager (f/m/d), you are part of the Delos Cloud Information Security Management System (ISMS) team within our IT Security organization. As functional expert you are part of our ISMS team who is responsible for defining and implementing organizational measures that help us protect our cloud platform from the various threats in this environment. For this purpose, you will also work with the regulatory authorities responsible for us. Furthermore, you act as an interface to GRC, technical IT security and all other departments.
At our company, security is part of our core brand, not just a cost center. With your experience, you will protect Germany's only sovereign Azure Cloud and make a valuable contribution to the digitization of our country.

•    Identification and assessment of security risks and supporting the departments in implementing measures
•    Preparing for internal and external audits

•    Collaborate with Delos Cloud subject matter experts to identify and implement security measures

jobs.occupation: VP Strategic HR Business Partner - CSO (all genders) (HR Business Partner)
jobs.description:
The VP Strategic HR Business Partner (SHRBP) for the Chief Scientific Officer (CSO) is a strategic leadership role responsible for aligning people strategy with Evotec’s overarching goals, particularly in the realms of AI, innovation, Therapeutic Area expertise and scientific excellence. Reporting to the Head of HR Business Partners, this position serves as a trusted advisor to the CSO and their global leadership team, driving initiatives that enable Evotec’s success in cutting-edge, high-performance environments.

The GHRBP works closely with senior leaders to shape and define the company’s AI and innovation strategy from a people perspective, ensuring that talent, organizational structures, and culture enable the company’s scientific and technological ambitions. This role partners with HR Centers of Expertise (CoEs) and local HRBP Communities teams to implement integrated, data-driven HR solutions that foster business agility, drive transformation, and enhance Evotec’s position as a leader in partnership with the life sciences, AI, and biotech sectors.

Key Deliverables and Accountabilities 

Strategic Partnership & Advisory

- Act as a strategic partner to the CSO, advising on all elements of the HR value chain, including organizational design, talent acquisition, leadership development, and succession planning.
- Partner with the CSO and other business leaders to help define and develop the organizational capabilities and talent needs to support the CSO function
- Lead the alignment and execution of the Global Evotec People Strategy with the company’s scientific vision, ensuring that the people strategy is a catalyst for growth, innovation, and competitive advantage.
- Talent Strategy and People Solutions Partner with senior leadership to define and implement a forward-looking talent strategy that enables Evotec’s AI and innovation ambitions.
- Provide strategic insight into the design and development of the company’s innovation culture, ensuring the people agenda is fully aligned with fostering creativity, agility, and a future-ready workforce.
- Collaborate closely with leadership to create organizational structures that support Evotec’s transformation ambitions.
- Advise CSO and Leadership Team on all people-related matters.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

- Serve as the primary HR interface with the CoE leaders in Total Rewards, Workforce Solutions, Talent Management, and HR Operations, ensuring seamless alignment between the people strategy and business objectives
- Build and nurture relationships with executive leadership, local HR teams, and functional leaders to ensure the consistent implementation of strategic HR initiatives across geographies.
- Serve as a key partner in driving collaboration between HR and technology leaders, helping to foster a culture of innovation and high performance across the organization.

Organizational Effectiveness & Transformation

- Lead efforts to define and address organizational capability gaps that hinder business and innovation performance.
- Design and implement change management initiatives that enable organizational agility

jobs.employer_name: Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen
jobs.description:
Job posting no. 20260820

The GWDG is seeking an

HPC Systems & Scheduling Developer (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours per week), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running till October 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (see responsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code is human-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification without AI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing center for the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society. The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the University of Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is a partner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the German Aerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchers and students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, and engineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantum computing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection for industry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies a tool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science (CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with an opportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing, Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus: Connecting quantum workloads to GWDG’s existing HPC infrastructure. Requires a deep understanding of both classical HPC architectures and the specific characteristics of quantum jobs. The developer will take responsibility for scheduler logic, including:

- SLURM partition mapping
- Optimization of SLURM execution for Quantum Computing Jobs
- Implement HPC transpilation pipelines and, more generally, workflows for HPC/AI pre- and post-processing
- Performance tuning of hybrid workloads
- Implementation of monitoring and benchmarking mechanisms

Requirements

- PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrable industry or research experience
- Ability to code in Python
- Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.
- Demonstrable expertise in optimizing HPC stacks for proper system implementation and tuning
- Experience building and operating software-based services, ensuring long-term maintainability
- Knowledge in QC (quantum computing) job characteristics and resource requirements, and familiarity with compiler/transpiler pipelines
- Excellent teamwork and communication skills
- Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

- Demonstrable experience tuning SLURM (partitioning, QoS, job prioritization policies) in a production HPC environment
- Experience benchmarking and profiling hybrid classical/quantum or GPU workloads
- Experience enabling optimal, resource-efficient operation of hybrid classical/quantum workloads
- Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling for HPC systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana)
- Background in systems administration or DevOps for research computing infrastructure
- German B2 or higher

Our offer

- Flexible working hours and opportunity for partial mobile working
- A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry
- An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center
- Qualification and further development of your skills
- Social benefits of the public sector

Your application

Have we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 30.09.2026 via our online form: https://bewerbermanagement.net/fpnhs

The GWDG strives for gender equity and diversity and therefore welcomes applications from any background. The GWDG strives to employ more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expressly encouraged.

If you have any questions about the advertised position, please contact Dr. Jan Cillié Louw (e-mail: jancillie.louw@gwdg.de).
